core.headline: New-build semi-detached house, Kings Hill, West Malling
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house at Orchard Rise, Kings Hill, West Malling, with an air source heat pump, underfloor heating to the ground floor and an EV charging point. Completion is expected spring 2027. The property is freehold with no onward chain and comes with a 10-year NHBC warranty.

The ground floor comprises a living room 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10") and a kitchen/dining room 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2"). The first floor has a principal bedroom 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with en-suite, two further bedrooms and a family bathroom. Heating is by air source heat pump, with underfloor heating downstairs and radiators upstairs.

Outside is a turfed rear garden with patio. Two allocated parking spaces are included, with an EV charging point.

Kings Hill is approx. 2 miles from West Malling station.

Fixed Price £410,000. Freehold. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating: B. EPC B is a predicted rating (SAP); the final EPC will be issued on completion. Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026.
